name: Satellite maneuver publication benchmark v1.0
data_attribution: Basic SSA orbital data from Space-Track.org, operated by U.S. Space Command. Public maneuver evidence is cited per case.
qualification: Positive-unlabelled publication benchmark. Event-evidence intervals are scored only where a public source documents a maneuver; predictions elsewhere in those cases remain unscored. Verified-quiet controls require explicit evidence that maneuvering had ceased, was unavailable, or required no further assistance. Unlabelled periods are never negatives.

split_policy.rule: Every NORAD object belongs to exactly one split. Confirmatory objects are frozen before any v1.0 detector tuning or confirmatory scoring.
split_policy.development_note: May be inspected and used for model development.
split_policy.calibration_note: May be used for calibration and operational threshold/risk setting.
split_policy.confirmatory_note: Must remain untouched by detector tuning and performance inspection until the final confirmatory run.

label_policy.event_evidence: Only documented truth intervals score true positives/false negatives. Predictions outside those intervals remain unscored.
label_policy.verified_quiet: Only intervals with explicit authoritative evidence that orbital maneuvering had ceased, was unavailable, or required no further assistance contribute false-positive exposure.
label_policy.unlabelled: Unlabelled time is never treated as negative ground truth.

external_label_provenance.licence: CC-BY-4.0 for the external dataset's authored recipe/parsed-label artifacts; underlying public sources retain their own terms.
